_comment: Phase 1 task 20. Hard targets per the VPS-but-simpler spec §6: LCP < 2.5s, INP < 200ms, CLS < 0.1, Lighthouse Perf >= 90, SEO >= 95, A11y >= 90, Best Practices >= 90. Runs on each PR that touches public-page surfaces (see .github/workflows/lighthouse.yml).

collect._comment_puppeteer: Signs in via /dev/login before auditing /dashboard/* URLs. Requires WOKKU_ENABLE_DEV_LOGIN=1 on the Rails server.

settings._comment_preset: Override per-PR via env LHCI_PRESET=mobile when we want a mobile audit. Desktop is the dev-loop default — closer to what we can hit on a Rails dev/test server.

assertions._comment_uses_text_compression: Brotli/gzip is handled by Kamal proxy in prod, not by Rails directly. Skip in CI so dev-server runs don't trip.
